newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu ends flat vs dlr, money market down.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu ends flat vs dlr, money market down.

text.p: 1320 GMT - The Romanian leu currency closed Friday steady at 3,230/40 to the dollar after inching down in early trading on a quieter interbank market.
* The leu has slid modestly against the dollar this week, easing some 30 units, but traders said the market remained still short of hard currency.
* They said focus in intrabank trading stayed on other currencies, which at cross yield rates closer to leu-dollar retail prices of some 3,550.
* Latest central bank data showed a $30,000 interbank volume on Thursday, when overall trading was $12.4 million.

* Short-term leu rates dipped towards 51 percent from a previous 55 with players adjusting their prices in line with a fall in the average one-week rate on the central bank's refinancing funds to 51 percent from last week's 58.4 percent. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
